formatter.context: Each source is the only declaration of a signature file whose first line is `module LibTmux.FSharp.Probe`, so a val starts at column 0. A member is written inside `type T =` at indent 4 with max_line_length raised by four, and the result is dedented by four columns.
formatter.regenerate: Write each source into its own .fsi file under an .editorconfig for its width, run `fantomas <directory>`, and copy the formatted declaration back. A case Fantomas cannot parse or whose output it rejects is left out.
